jobs.occupation: Technical Project Manager - Data & Migration Team
jobs.description:
As our next Technical Project Manager in the Data & Migrations team, you will contribute to solving meaningful challenges across the life sciences industry. We offer specialised management consulting services, working with top-tier life sciences companies as well as biotech startups — locally and globally. From strategy development to hands-on implementation, we support our clients were impact matters most

About the role

This is a Senior role designed to provide program leadership to deliver strategic technical solutions that address complex client issues in the Life Sciences industry. As a manager within the Migration team, you will be handling projects and programs with regards to migration implementation to achieve desired outcomes and ensure successful business growth and regulatory compliance. You will also seek new business opportunities to help BASE life science grow its presence within existing and new customers.

You will provide program/project management oversight for all customer implementations falling under the Migrations team’s scope.

You will lead project teams consisting of data engineers/scientists. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data engineering, project management and the ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications.

As a Technical Project Manager for the Migration team your responsibilities include:

• Monitoring program status including milestones, risks, issues, budgets, etc.

• Acting as a delivery escalation point and proactively ensuring escalations are handled promptly with a clear action and communication plan.

• Providing executive level summaries for senior executives in BASE life science.

• Intervening, when necessary, to ensure costs, timelines and quality are on track.

• Developed plans and effort estimates for future project during sales process.

Delivering Projects:

• Lead a cross-functional team to deliver data driven projects on time, within budget, and to the satisfaction of our life science industry stakeholders.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders in the life science industry to understand their data needs and translate them into technical specifications for the project team.

• Develop project plans, timelines, and budgets for the projects.

• Track and report on project progress, identifying and mitigating risks as needed.

• Facilitate communication and collaboration between the project team, life science industry stakeholders, and other teams within BASE life science.

What makes you the best person for this job?

• 5+ years of experience as a technical project manager ideally within the life science industry or other regulated areas.

• Successful track record of managing technically complex projects such as software development, implementation of IT systems, data migrations, etc.

• Experience leading developers, data engineers and/or data scientists and delivering data driven projects.

• Experience with project management tools such as JIRA.

• Experience with Agile project management methodologies such as SAFe.

• Strong communication skills, both in writing, meetings and in presentations.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

• A genuine interest in understanding the technical aspects of complex data-driven projects.

Additionally, the ideal candidate has the following qualifications:

• Experience with coding in Python, VBA, Java, R, SQL, C, or similar.

• Experience selling either projects or products to clients.

• Experience working with Veeva Vault.

This position is offered in Copenhagen, Denmark and Barcelona, Spain.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2007, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting enterprise working exclusively in the life sciences industry.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Europe and the United States, we support clients globally. We work closely with our customers to identify, develop, and implement initiatives that drive growth, efficiency, and meaningful change. Through partnerships with leading solution providers such as Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Benchling, and MediSpend, we help our clients unlock the full potential of modern technologies.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact.

You will be part of a collaborative, high‑performing environment where:

• Ambition is encouraged through ownership and continuous learning

• Execution matters — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice

• Team spirit and trust guide collaboration across roles, countries, and disciplines

• Openness means your ideas are heard, you are challenged constructively, and supported as you grow

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance

• Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

If you find this position intriguing, don't delay—submit your application in English at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application.

At BASE Life Science, we value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Employment decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs

By submitting your application, you consent to the processing of your personal data by BASE life science for the purposes of recruitment and selection. This includes the collection, storage, and use of your personal data as outlined in our Privacy Policy.

jobs.occupation: Global Business Services (GBS) Finance Transformation Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description

With more than 2,700 employees, Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, Technology, and Transformations.

About our team

Finance Transformation is part of Deloitte’s consulting practice and consists of 350 dedicated consultants who work within all aspects of the CFO area and engage with clients to advise, transform, optimise, and operate the finance function. We have private and public as well as national and international clients across different industries and of different sizes, and we work with the lion’s share of C25 companies and public institutions.

Global Business Services (GBS) is an integral part of Deloitte’s Finance Transformation practice. The GBS team is dedicated to helping organizations transform their business operations, driving higher efficiency, effectiveness, and agility. By leveraging a comprehensive suite of services, the GBS practice supports clients in optimizing shared services, outsourcing, and global business service models to create value and enhance performance.

We are seeking an experienced and skilled Transformation Manager to join our GBS team. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of operating model structures and Business Process Re-engineering driven through the lens of cost optimization and efficiency augmentation, experience with the interplay of technology and process design, and change management capabilities. This role will be pivotal in driving strategic business transformation initiatives, focusing on re-enforcing cost optimization strategies by energizing core operational processes and technology design and implementation phases (ERP, process mining, automation and visualization tools).

Job Description

As a Transformation Manager, you will lead large complex engagements for some of the world's biggest organizations. You will identify, design, and implement creative business and technology solutions aimed at driving operational effectiveness, cost efficiencies and organizational agility. In this role, you will architect strategies and transformation programs that will enable process excellence and value creation by optimizing day-to-day operational finance functions using lean methodology in end-to-end process areas such as order to cash, procure to pay, close, consolidation, reporting. You will be responsible for leading business model transformations and cultivating enterprise agility to ensure transformations are anchored in, and unlock, value.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

• Leading Project Delivery

• Driving large scale transformations, complex and cross functional engagements

• Advising clients on process re-engineering and process optimization to support enterprise-wide decision-making, improve finance operations, and strengthen stakeholder management

• Lead the technology solution design and implementation ensuring high quality adhering to the timelines and defined budget

• Engaging in Executive- Level Interactions

• Partner with C-level executives to address strategic objectives and challenges.

• Present actionable strategies in clear, compelling terms.

• Driving Business Development

• Lead RFPs/ proposal preparation by collaborating across competencies/ alliances/ service lines.

• Cultivate and nurture client relationships beyond project delivery, exploring avenues for repeat business.

• Stakeholder Management

• Build and maintain strong connections with CXOs across various sectors.

• Project Financials

• Manage budgets and financial performance for your projects.

• Mentorship and Team Culture-

• Mentor and guide a team of consultants, fostering a positive and collaborative culture.

• Encourage professional growth and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

Ideally, you have:

• Around 6-9 years of relevant experience in finance transformation, finance process excellence, GBS, Shared Services and/or BPO sector

• 4+ years of Direct people management experience

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited university

• Fluency in Danish is a big plus

What you bring to the team:

• Experience with process excellence, including but not limited to end-to-end process areas such as order to cash, procure to pay, close, consolidation, reporting

• Knowledge of GBS lifecycle and able to run projects in it as a Project Manager

• Experience with enabling technologies in core finance processes (e.g., Basware, HighRadius, BlackLine, etc.)

• Experience in using tools for process mining, visualization tools, Robotics Process Automation (RPA) and understanding of GenAI opportunities in driving transformation

• Strong process expertise in transforming and optimizing day-to-day operational functions (e.g. finance, HR) using lean methodology

• Experience in designing leading practice-based processes and driving the entire journey from assessment, design to implementation

• Superior critical thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills

• Exceptional interpersonal, team-building and oral and written communication skills; outstanding integrity, initiative, creativity, and passion

• Experience with ServiceNow, Salesforce or other customer-oriented workflow platforms

• Baseline understanding and position on the current and future applications of Artificial Intelligence in GBS

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?

Click the "I am interested" button above if you are ready to join our team.

Send your CV by 30.11.2026. We process applications and arrange interviews continually, so we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.

Expected start date: Flexible

Please do not hesitate to contact Nadiia Novikova at nshamarina@deloitte.dk if you have any questions about the position.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

About Us

Tandoori Twist is an offering from Tinyhus Cafe, a child-friendly cafe in Copenhagen, Denmark, serving authentic Indian delicacies.

We serve not only classic favourites like butter chicken and biriyani, but also lesser known Indian regional food, with myriad of spices and flavours as our specilities.

Our people, just like our food, are the ambassadors of our cafe and restaurant. If you like challenges and you are looking for a place where you can contribute positively, overcoming the odds of a new but growing restaurant, then please do get in touch; we will look forward to hear from you.

Job Description

If you have similar experience, especially in Asian / Indian restaurant and are proactive & quick-learner, then please feel free to contact us.

Only applications through our career site will be considered https://www.tandooritwist.dk/tandooritwist-career/

Job description

• 
Washing plates, pots, pans, utensils and kitchen equipment.

• 
Keeping the dish washing area clean and organized

•

This is a part-time position. The work is mainly in the evening and also during weekends. Please note that you need to have right to work in Denmark as work-permit will not be sponsored for this position.

Requirements

Your profile:

• 
It is mandatory to have prior experience in kitchen and familiarity with Indian cuisine

• 
You are fluent in English.

• 
You are reliable and punctual.

• 
You are proactive and structured in your work.

• 
You have strong attention to detail and cleanliness.

• 
You can work in a fast-paced environment.

• 
You are able to work 2-3 hours daily for 3-4 times a week.

• 
Since this is a part-time position, work-permit will not be sponsored for this position. Unless you have a valid residence and work permit to work in Denmark, your application will not be proceeded with.

We take continuous interviews and the positions are closed as soon as we find the right candidate. Only shortlisted candidates will be communicated for interview.

Tinyhus is a newly established child-friendly cafe, located in Søborg. At Tinyhus, we are committed to provide our customers with an experience. Not only delicious food at affordable prices and great quality coffee on the plate, but also the ambience and our coxy outdoor space which makes our customers feel relaxed and longing more. We improve our menu on continuous basis and if you are passionate about food and beverages and have experience as a cook, kitchen assistant, cafe-worker, barista or bartender, we would like to hear from you.

Vacancies

Cook (Continental food)

Are you a passionate cook who loves preparing continental dishes? Are you a proactive person who enjoys providing good service with a smile? Do you have experience in cafe kitchen preparing hot and cold dishes, coffee and can keep things clean and tidy? Then it’s you we are looking for- Tinyhus, a newly established child-friendly café located in Copenhagen, looking for team member.

Job description

Your task will be to prepare food, both hot and cold dishes for the customers. We improve our menu on periodic basis and we hope you would love to introduce new dishes in our menu.

You will handle the orders, prepare food and handle take-away deliveries when required.

The work is mainly during daytime and also during weekends.

Your profile:

• You are truly passionate about delicious but simplistic food.

• You have worked in cafe / restaurants and have experience in continental cuisines, especially Italian and / or Spanish cuisines.

• You can communicate in English

• It is an advantage if you having baking experience (breads, cakes or cookies)

• You can prepare coffee and have knowledge of drinks (wines)

• You are a proactive person who takes responsibility and hands-on ownership of the tasks and flexible when it comes to responsibilities and tasks typical for a small but growing organisation

Please note that you need to have right to work in Denmark as work-permit will not be sponsored for this position.

Please send your application and CV through the application form. We take interviews continuously and the job will be closed as soon as we get the right candidate.

We are very much looking forward to hearing from you!

Job Type: Part-time (15-20 hrs / week)

jobs.occupation: Financial Data Management Consultant, Datadriven Banking, Netcompany Banking Services
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping the financial sector turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.

Netcompany Banking Services

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities & technologies

You will become part of a team that enables our customers to develop and manage their businesses through data and insights, working at the intersection of technology and finance. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data. To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in financial data management.

Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• 
Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.

• 
Structuring and collection of data from various sources.

• 
Implementation of financial business logic on data for use in reporting.

• 
Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.

• 
Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.

About you

You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within finance and data management, probably from a bank, an asset manager or similar. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex financial data and challenges. You thrive in an environment focused on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:

• 
ETL and Database technologies.

• 
Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.

• 
Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.

• 
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

• 
The financial sector, including regulatory reporting in the banking sector.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

We are seeking a full-time to join our team in Svinninge.

Do you want to package world-class quality beer?

We are looking for a dedicated Packaging Operator to join our production team. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to participate in filling world-class beer in various formats, including cans, bottles, and kegs. Additionally, you will be responsible for troubleshooting, performing minor services, and maintaining the filling equipment in collaboration with our technicians.

Who is To Øl?

To Øl is a young Danish craft brewery founded in 2010. We are striving to deliver the highest quality beer and get it into the hands of people in the most sustainable way. In 2019, we acquired the old Beauvais factory in Svinninge, where we established a modern brewery. We brew a wide range of different beers, and our commitment to quality and innovation has enabled us to export our products to more than 31 countries.

Our company consists of over 80 dedicated people with different skills from 23 countries. We have different backgrounds, life stories, and areas of expertise, and we love this diversity because we believe it makes our work and products better.

What does this role involve?

We offer a full-time position within the Industrial Agreement. The job is characterized by strong teamwork, the opportunity for independence, and decision-making.

Your daily routine includes:

• 
Operating filling equipment on the bottle, can, and keg lines.

• 
Ongoing adjustment and maintenance of the machines to minimize potential downtime.

• 
Ensuring that quality control is maintained throughout the entire process.

• 
Adhering to the production schedule to ensure all orders are completed correctly, including products in the right packaging, with the correct label, and the proper date/batch number.

• 
Constant troubleshooting on the line in close collaboration with the People manager and equipment suppliers.

• 
Handling ad hoc tasks within the packaging and brewing team, and maintenance as needed.

• 
Continuous cleaning and tidying during and after the day.

You will report directly to our Packaging Manager, Matias Frank.

You will thrive in this role if you:

• 
If you possess a strong sense of safety, quality, and teamwork.

• 
Enjoy working in a team with coworkers of different backgrounds and skills.

• 
Can adapt to an occasionally hectic workday.

• 
Can multitask in a fast-paced environment.

• 
Are organised and responsible with a problem-solving attitude.

• 
Are physically active and comfortable with standing and being in motion.

• 
If you feel comfortable doing repetitive tasks.

Your qualifications:

• 
You have at least 2 years of experience in a similar position, working with production equipment, preferably in the brewing, food, or beverage industry.

• 
You possess technical aptitude.

• 
You hold a valid forklift driver's license (Preferable)

• 
Be able to communicate fluently in both English and Danish (Preferable)

We offer you:

• 
A workplace where you can develop both personally and professionally.

• 
A work culture based on the belief that freedom with responsibility creates the best conditions for successful work.

• 
An outstanding opportunity to work at one of the world's most prestigious breweries.

• 
An open and inclusive workplace that promotes teamwork and innovation.

• 
A culture where we celebrate our successes and learn from our mistakes.

Do you want to be part of our team?

Then we would love to hear from you! Applications will be processed as they are received:

• 
Application deadline: Review an ongoing basis

• 
Job start: ASAP

Contact person

Matias Frank matias@to-ol.dk

We look forward to hearing from you and welcoming you to our team.

SOUNDBOKS is an innovative tech company and aspiring lifestyle brand. You may have seen us at a music festival, street party, or your friend’s celebration (think: private events combining festival-grade sound with beat-enhancing lights) where special moments are turned into memories. We create the loudest, most durable, and arguably coolest Bluetooth speakers and audio reactive lights on the market.

At SOUNDBOKS, trust and community go hand in hand. People are encouraged to take ownership of their work while knowing they have the support of the team behind them. Voices are heard, ideas are welcomed, and collaboration is what pushes us forward.

This is more than a job - it’s a community where people care about each other, celebrate together, and share the energy of creating something meaningful. Life at SOUNDBOKS is bold, fast, and full of passion - for the product, for the mission, and for showing up as your true self. With 70 team members, this is a place where you can do your best work and truly belong.

ROLE ACOUSTIC ENGINEER

TEAM PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

HOURS FULL TIME

LOCATION COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

START DATE OCTOBER 2026 or ASAP

The Product Development team at SOUNDBOKS is the group responsible for the exciting product journey, taking every step of the development process toward and into mass production. In it’s heartbeat you’ll find collaborative and self-driven team members with a large cross-discipline understanding tied to ownership. They are there to make a difference - for the products, the team and the SOUNDBOKS customers as a whole.

Every SOUNDBOKS starts with a great idea - but turning it into a speaker that can survive a festival, run for hours, and sound incredible takes a lot of engineering. As the Acoustic Engineer, you'll be taking charge of the acoustic development that helps bring those products to life.

Okay, let’s make things a little more concrete. Here’s what we expect your daily life to look like:

Concept & Prototype Development

• 
You'll select and design acoustic components based on product and market requirements.

• 
You'll define initial enclosure concepts.

• 
You'll build and evaluate proof-of-concept prototypes to validate acoustic concepts.

• 
You'll collaborate with Mechanical Engineering during the early product development phase to mature acoustic concepts.

Simulation & Validation

• 
You'll perform acoustic simulations with a focus on sound pressure level (SPL), sound quality, and system efficiency.

• 
You'll validate simulation results through physical testing.

• 
You'll collaborate with suppliers to refine acoustic components based on simulation and test results.

Driver Specification & Verification

• 
You'll own the technical specification of loudspeaker drivers towards suppliers.

• 
You'll define driver specifications and tolerances.

• 
You'll support manufacturing verification with suppliers.

• 
You'll participate in the acoustic verification of the final product towards mass production.

• 
You'll collaborate with the Audio team on audio signal handling, including crossovers, compressors, and limiters.

Job requirements

In order to become a success in this role, we believe that your profile should be aligned with the bullets listed below. However, we acknowledge that success can take many forms, so please do apply even if you don’t tick all the boxes.

• 
You have proven experience designing and simulating loudspeakers, including transducer design and specification, enclosure design, and acoustic measurements.

• 
You hold a BSc or higher in Audio, Acoustics, Mechanical, or a related engineering discipline.

• 
You've done loudspeaker simulation and measurements, and use both to validate and refine your designs.

• 
You've worked with loudspeaker development from concept through verification and ideally have experience collaborating with external manufacturing partners.

• 
Familiarity with crossover design, FEM simulations, or failure analysis is an advantage.

• 
Ideally you also have experience building physical speaker mock-ups or collaborating with large-scale loudspeaker manufacturing partners.

• 
You work independently, take ownership of your area, and enjoy collaborating closely with engineers across disciplines.

• 
You're curious, creative, and constantly looking for ways to improve acoustic performance.

• 
You're drawn to what SOUNDBOKS is building and are excited to be a part of the journey!

Intrigued? At SOUNDBOKS you’ll find yourself a part of a community. We realize that growth is a process and we don’t expect you to go through it alone. Actually, we guarantee that you won’t have to. We work together in order to work smarter, we inspire each other to be better, and we never forget that every member of the team is responsible for our success.

So, if you’re tired of all of the noise in the job market, we’d love to hear from you. This may be the coolest job you ever have!

We develop solutions for a wide range of clients, from smaller private companies to large-scale public sector projects. Regardless of the project size, you as a Business Consultant will make a noticeable impact together with some of the industry’s most talented colleagues.

Your work will be tied to our large-scale projects across both the public and private sectors.

You will also play a key role in making sure users have the right capabilities and readiness, so that both users and the organisation are fully prepared when new solutions go live.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

If you enjoy solving complex challenges and creating value for clients, and have specific experience with OneStream, AMCO Solutions offers an ideal environment for you to thrive. Experience in other CPM software solutions is also a relevant background.

Job Description

As a Senior Consultant, your responsibilities will include:

•   Engaging in all phases of the project lifecycle, from gathering requirements to building solutions and supporting client’s post-launch.

•   Collaborating with a skilled, diverse team to address challenging business needs and deliver effective solutions, ensuring OneStream is utilized to its full

•   potential.

•   Leading project tasks and ensuring timely, high-quality delivery in accordance with project scope.

•   Mentoring and coaching colleagues while contributing to the overall knowledge-sharing within the team.

•   Actively participating in internal initiatives to help AMCO maintain its position as a leader in implementation of OneStream solutions.

Requirements and Qualifications

•   A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in economics, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

•   3-4 years of CPM implementation experience, including system design, project management, and change management. Specific knowledge of OneStream

•   Software is an advantage.

•   A solid understanding of accounting & finance principles (preferred).

•   OneStream certification is a strong plus, and experience with the software is highly preferred for this role.

Perks and Benefits

•   Professional Development: Access to training and certifications in OneStream, and continuous learning opportunities.

•   Work-Life Balance: Flexibility in working hours and the opportunity to collaborate with a global team across various time zones.

•   Competitive Compensation: We offer a competitive salary package, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for career advancement.

Do you get a small, slightly nerdy kick out of working out why a conversion stopped firing three weeks ago and nobody noticed?

At Helion B2B we don't just "run ads" for our clients. We build data-driven growth engines for some of the most ambitious B2B companies in Europe. But an engine is only as good as its sensors. That's where you come in.

You won't just keep the engine running. You'll help build it.

You'll join our tracking team in Aarhus, working day to day with our Tracking Lead. Real ownership early, someone who has done all of it sitting right next to you, and a direct hand in how the practice develops. We have standards, and we like them being challenged. If you think we're doing something the hard way, we'd rather hear it in week two than in year two.

You'll work across all of it: new implementations, server-side setups, multi-market containers, consent, QA, troubleshooting, and the measurement plans that hold it together. Real clients, and real responsibility for whether their measurement holds up.

Some of that is building something new. A lot of it is taking a setup that already exists and making it better than you found it, which is where data quality actually comes from. Your scope over the clients you look after grows from there.

The job doesn't stop when the data arrives. Part of the work is reporting and analysis: helping a client see what their numbers are telling them, and noticing when a number is telling them something wrong. Mostly technical work, then, but not only

Your playground

• 
Google Tag Manager: Web containers from day one, server-side (sGTM) as you grow into it.

• 
GA4: Event design, debugging, and making sure the numbers actually mean something.

• 
HubSpot: we're an Elite HubSpot partner, so tracking data and CRM data have to meet properly.

• 
Consent management: Cookiebot and Cookie Information, Consent Mode, and the GDPR reality behind them.

• 
Data Studio and reporting: Turning all of the above into something a client can read and act on, and being able to say what it means.

• 
AI-assisted tracking: We're actively building agent-supported auditing, monitoring and insight workflows. You'll use them, break them, and help shape where they go next.

What you need on day one

• 
You can build and debug tags, triggers and variables in a web GTM container on your own. Preview mode and Tag Assistant are familiar territory.

• 
You can configure and debug GA4, and you know what to start checking when a dimension comes back as (not set).

• 
You're a finisher. "Done" means tested and verified, not deployed.

• 
You think for yourself. When you hit a wall, you research, test and come back with a proposal rather than waiting for instructions.

• 
You're curious about where AI is taking this field. You don't need experience with it. You need to want to poke at it.

Somewhere around three to five years of hands-on tracking experience, from an agency or in-house, is the usual shape. It's a guide, not a gate.

What you'll learn here

Server-side GTM and Conversions API. Consent Mode in depth. HubSpot data flows. BigQuery. Multi-market container architecture. Reporting and analysis on top of GA4 and BigQuery. B2B lead cycles, and why they make tracking a harder problem than e-commerce.

Experience with any of these is an advantage. None of them are requirements. You'll have a lead who would rather teach you properly than do it twice.

The practical bits

• 
Where: Our Aarhus office, with a minimum of three days a week on site.

• 
Language: We work in English. Danish is an advantage, not a requirement.

• 
Right to work: You must already hold the right to work in Denmark: EU/EEA citizenship, or a valid Danish work and residence permit.

• 
Everyday life: Lunch scheme and flexible hours. We care that the work lands, not that you were at your desk at 08:30.

• 
Pension and insurance: Company-paid pension and health insurance (sundhedsforsikring).

• 
Growing here: We back training and certifications, and you'll have a lead who would rather you learned something new than closed one more ticket.

• 
The social side: fredagsbar, summer party, julefrokost and a yearly off-site. If you're new to Denmark, ask about the julefrokost.

> Earlier in your career than the above, but the rest of this sounds like you? Apply anyway and tell us where you're at. We'd rather shape the level around the right person than miss them.

Business-to-business, person-to-person

Helion B2B is a fast-growing, Elite HubSpot partner that helps B2B companies build growth engines.

We are an ambitious, curious team genuinely passionate about our work. We are eager to learn, value great social relationships and are not afraid of challenging ourselves and our clients if we feel that there is a better way to solve a challenge.

You can read more about us, our customers and what we do on helionb2b.com or on our HubSpot Directory page.

Let's talk business-to-business, person-to-person

For more information or questions please contact us at job@helionb2b.com

Support a 9-year-old boy in Skævinge

Jobbeskrivelse

Do you have experience working with children with special needs, and do you enjoy an active one-to-one role? Then you could become an important source of support for a 9-year-old boy who loves movement, play and safe, predictable routines.

About the role

You will provide regular one-to-one support for a 9-year-old boy with autism and an intellectual disability. He needs close support, clear structure and a calm approach that helps create predictability.

The boy is energetic, enjoys being active and particularly likes outdoor play, trips to the playground and running in the woods. He also enjoys activities such as puzzles, music, bubbles, balloons and sensory toys. Your role is to plan and take part in activities that match his pace and needs. As he has limited awareness of danger, it is important that you stay close to him and remain attentive to his surroundings.

The role includes assistance with personal care, including bathing, changing diapers and toilet training. You will also provide support at mealtimes, with a focus on motivating and guiding him towards gradually becoming more independent.

The boy does not communicate verbally and uses only a few English words. It is therefore important that you are able to communicate in English, including with his parents, who do not speak Danish.

The boy has food allergies and has an EpiPen, which must be used in the event of an allergic reaction. The family will provide thorough instructions on its use. He also has asthma, and his parents are responsible for all medication management.

About you

You may be a qualified pedagogue/social educator or have relevant experience working with children with special needs. You approach the child with calmness, patience and clarity, and you enjoy an active working environment where you take part in play and physical activities.

At the same time, you are able to create structure and a sense of security, be attentive and provide clear boundaries when needed. As communication with the family takes place in English, you must be able to communicate confidently in English.

A driving licence is an advantage. Alternatively, you must be comfortable using the family’s cargo bike, which will be provided.

Working hours

The position is for 16 hours per week. The working hours are:

Two weekdays per week: 3 hours after school, from 2:30 pm to 5:30 pm

Thursdays: 9:30 am to 1:30 pm (4 hours)

Sundays: 11:00 am to 5:00 pm

What we offer

You will become part of a family-owned company with many dedicated employees. You will have a dedicated adviser who is available for guidance and support. Outside office hours, a staffed emergency phone line is always available, so you are never on your own.

Salary and pension are provided in accordance with the national collective agreement between FOA and the Danish Chamber of Commerce (Dansk Erhverv). You are covered by DUOS’ liability and occupational injury insurance, and health insurance is included as part of your pension scheme.

We offer a wide range of courses, and as a DUOS employee, you will receive relevant induction and ongoing professional development. Working with people at DUOS also gives you the opportunity to develop both personally and professionally.

Would you like to become our new colleague?

Please submit your application via the link. You must have a profile on mit.duos.dk and be logged in to apply. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. The position is available for an immediate start.

If you have any further questions, please contact Recruitment Consultant Trine Ankær Johansen on +45 36 34 49 90. You can also find answers to general questions in our FAQ.

We are people helping people

At DUOS, we help people in their everyday lives, support them through challenging situations and contribute to their well-being and quality of life. As one of Denmark’s largest and longest-established welfare service providers, we strive to be there where support is needed.

We understand the importance of combining empathy with the right professional expertise, and we know that finding the right match between an employee and the person receiving support is essential for our services to make a meaningful difference.

Join the DUOS team and make an important difference in another person’s life.

Learn more about DUOS at www.duos.dk.

You're more product manager than a traditional consultant, with a strong strategic angle - closer to an Engagement Manager who's technical enough to make the right calls than a slide-deck advisor.

Sequencing what gets built, in what order, and being accountable for the business value - not just the artifact

Spotting where the next opportunity sits inside an account and growing it

Why Heyra

jobs.occupation: Accounting & Reporting Advisory – Assistant Manager to Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description

With more than 3,000 employees, Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, Technology and Transformations.

Join our growth journey with our Accounting & Reporting Advisory team (ARA)

You will become a part of our Accounting & Reporting Advisory team (ARA), an ambitious group dedicated to creating value by advising on complex accounting and external reporting needs. This includes conversion to IFRS, preparation of IFRS financial statements in connection with conversions or improvements, technical accounting analyses and issues, solving general accounting problems, improvement of financial reporting processes and control environments, and various M&A accounting services.

The Accounting & Reporting Advisory team is a component of our Assurance Offerings department that specializes in advising CFO’s and finance functions on, amongst others, projects within accounting, ESG reporting & assurance, optimisation of financial processes, digital solutions as well as complex IFRS analysis and implementation projects.

In Assurance Offerings, we foster a culture that accommodates everyone, irrespective of their life situation. We place great importance on well-being and development, striving to create an environment where each talent can leverage their strengths and competencies.

Job Description

As part of our team, you will lead and participate in client projects using your specialised accounting knowledge and the Deloitte Toolkit. We are looking for candidates on a manager level who are capable of leading projects with up to five team members, being responsible for scoping projects in cooperation with clients and project partners, as well as supporting and advising clients’ corporate accounting and reporting teams.

We work with assistance and advice within:

• General assistance regarding IFRS (ad hoc questions or short/long-term temporary tasks)

• Supporting clients in optimizing their financial reporting processes, ensuring timely, efficient and quality external reporting

• Assisting clients with consolidations and system implementation, improving their close processes and financial data flows from source to report

• Practical assistance/advice on finance, accounting and reporting

• Conversions to IFRS

• Supporting the clients specialised finance function with analysing and documenting the accounting treatment of proposed or actual transactions

• Assistance with the due diligence process in connection with business transactions (e.g., selected accounting areas, preparation of memos, preparation of due diligence material)

• Accounting assistance after company acquisition to support subsequent integration

• Treasury accounting including design and implementation of hedge accounting and processes and controls supporting clients running an effective hedge accounting setup

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

Qualifications

• You are curious about accounting and accounting issues. You see opportunities and solutions, ask good questions to explore the framework, and create the best results. You see challenges as an exciting opportunity to bring your talent into play and are prepared to learn and solve often complex tasks from scratch.

• You have experience in the field. You have minimum 5 years of experience from a similar job within finance or accounting, e.g., auditor, finance manager, accounting manager, or consultant in a related area.

• You are a positive and independent team player. You take ownership of tasks and do not shy away from new challenges. You value and embrace diverse perspectives and collaborate to create security and trust among your colleagues and clients.

• You have a relevant master's degree in finance, accounting, or auditing.

• Fluent in English – Fluent in Danish is an advantage.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?

Click "I am interested" above if you are ready to be part of our team.

Send your application, CV, and a transcript of your latest education along with other relevant documents. We process applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we recommend that you send your application as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Amalie Andersen, Senior Manager, at +45 28 92 66 04.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team's success.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position, regardless of age, gender (gender identity or expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

• Automation of business processes.

About you

• Are in the final year of your bachelor’s degree or have started a master’s degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field.

• Have some experience with object-oriented programming and familiarity with languages such as C# .NET and/or Java.

• Are highly motivated and eager to develop your skills.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

About the job

Chainalysis is the cryptocurrency ghostbusters, pioneering in the blockchain analysis space. Identifying high-risk activities on the blockchain, playing a central role in ensuring cryptocurrencies are used for a legitimate purpose. Ultimately, Chainalysis is building trust in blockchains.

The Chainalysis engineering team solves large scale, technically complex data problems by ingesting, transforming and supporting nearly 1TB of data per day across multiple blockchains serving public and private sectors internationally. Our industry is evolving at a rapid pace and our job is to build a flexible platform that will allow us to adapt accordingly.
